---
title: Reference
---

Every public function in the library, grouped by role.

## [Core](core/index.qmd)

- [`aes`](core/aes.qmd) - Bind column names to visual channels to form an aesthetic mapping.
- [`as-factor`](core/as-factor.qmd) - Coerce a column to string factors, or tag an aesthetic as discrete.
- [`as-numeric`](core/as-numeric.qmd) - Coerce a column to numeric, or tag an aesthetic as continuous.
- [`plot`](core/plot.qmd) - Compose a layered plot from data, aesthetics, and geom layers.

## [Labs](labs/index.qmd)

- [`ggtitle`](labs/ggtitle.qmd) - Shortcut for setting the plot title (and optional subtitle).
- [`labs`](labs/labs.qmd) - Build a label dictionary for the plot title, subtitle, caption, and axes.
- [`xlab`](labs/xlab.qmd) - Shortcut for setting the x axis title.
- [`ylab`](labs/ylab.qmd) - Shortcut for setting the y axis title.

## [Geoms](geoms/index.qmd)

- [`geom-abline`](geoms/geom-abline.qmd) - Straight reference line described by slope and intercept.
- [`geom-bar`](geoms/geom-bar.qmd) - Bar layer that counts rows per x level (stat-count).
- [`geom-boxplot`](geoms/geom-boxplot.qmd) - Boxplot layer drawn from pre-computed quantile columns.
- [`geom-col`](geoms/geom-col.qmd) - Bar layer with heights taken from the y aesthetic.
- [`geom-histogram`](geoms/geom-histogram.qmd) - Histogram layer: bars of binned counts along the x aesthetic.
- [`geom-hline`](geoms/geom-hline.qmd) - Horizontal reference line at one or more y intercepts.
- [`geom-label`](geoms/geom-label.qmd) - Boxed text label layer reading strings from the `label` aesthetic.
- [`geom-line`](geoms/geom-line.qmd) - Line layer connecting observations in x order, one path per group.
- [`geom-point`](geoms/geom-point.qmd) - Scatterplot layer drawing a marker for each row at `(x, y)`.
- [`geom-ribbon`](geoms/geom-ribbon.qmd) - Filled band between `ymin` and `ymax` along the x aesthetic.
- [`geom-smooth`](geoms/geom-smooth.qmd) - Fitted trend line with an optional confidence ribbon.
- [`geom-text`](geoms/geom-text.qmd) - Text label layer reading strings from the `label` aesthetic.
- [`geom-vline`](geoms/geom-vline.qmd) - Vertical reference line at one or more x intercepts.

## [Stats](stats/index.qmd)

- [`stat-bin`](stats/stat-bin.qmd) - Bin statistic: partition x into uniform-width bins, count rows per bin.
- [`stat-count`](stats/stat-count.qmd) - Count statistic: one output row per distinct x level with `y = count`.
- [`stat-identity`](stats/stat-identity.qmd) - Identity statistic: returns data and mapping unchanged.
- [`stat-smooth`](stats/stat-smooth.qmd) - Smoother statistic: closed-form linear fit with a pointwise confidence band.

## [Scales](scales/index.qmd)

- [`scale-colour-continuous`](scales/scale-colour-continuous.qmd) - Continuous colour scale mapping a numeric column to stroke colours.
- [`scale-colour-discrete`](scales/scale-colour-discrete.qmd) - Discrete colour scale mapping categorical levels to stroke colours.
- [`scale-colour-manual`](scales/scale-colour-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete colour scale: supply the colour array directly.
- [`scale-colour-viridis-b`](scales/scale-colour-viridis-b.qmd) - Binned viridis colour scale.
- [`scale-colour-viridis-c`](scales/scale-colour-viridis-c.qmd) - Continuous viridis colour scale.
- [`scale-colour-viridis-d`](scales/scale-colour-viridis-d.qmd) - Discrete viridis colour scale.
- [`scale-fill-continuous`](scales/scale-fill-continuous.qmd) - Continuous fill scale mapping a numeric column to fill colours.
- [`scale-fill-discrete`](scales/scale-fill-discrete.qmd) - Discrete fill scale mapping categorical levels to fill colours.
- [`scale-fill-manual`](scales/scale-fill-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete fill scale: supply the colour array directly.
- [`scale-fill-viridis-b`](scales/scale-fill-viridis-b.qmd) - Binned viridis fill scale.
- [`scale-fill-viridis-c`](scales/scale-fill-viridis-c.qmd) - Continuous viridis fill scale.
- [`scale-fill-viridis-d`](scales/scale-fill-viridis-d.qmd) - Discrete viridis fill scale.
- [`scale-linetype`](scales/scale-linetype.qmd) - Discrete linetype scale: maps levels to dash-pattern keywords.
- [`scale-linetype-manual`](scales/scale-linetype-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete linetype scale: supply the dash-keyword array directly.
- [`scale-shape`](scales/scale-shape.qmd) - Discrete shape scale: maps levels to marker-shape keywords.
- [`scale-shape-manual`](scales/scale-shape-manual.qmd) - Manual discrete shape scale: supply the shape-keyword array directly.
- [`scale-size-continuous`](scales/scale-size-continuous.qmd) - Continuous size scale mapping a numeric column to a size range.
- [`scale-x-continuous`](scales/scale-x-continuous.qmd) - Continuous x scale: axis title, limits, breaks, labels, and transformation.
- [`scale-x-discrete`](scales/scale-x-discrete.qmd) - Discrete x scale: axis title, level ordering, and tick labels.
- [`scale-y-continuous`](scales/scale-y-continuous.qmd) - Continuous y scale: axis title, limits, breaks, labels, and transformation.
- [`scale-y-discrete`](scales/scale-y-discrete.qmd) - Discrete y scale: axis title, level ordering, and tick labels.

## [Coord](coord/index.qmd)

- [`coord-cartesian`](coord/coord-cartesian.qmd) - Cartesian coordinate system with optional panel clipping.

## [Positions](positions/index.qmd)

- [`position-dodge`](positions/position-dodge.qmd) - Dodge position adjustment: place grouped bars side by side.
- [`position-fill`](positions/position-fill.qmd) - Fill position adjustment: stack and normalise each x bucket to sum = 1.
- [`position-identity`](positions/position-identity.qmd) - Identity position adjustment: no offset applied to any row.
- [`position-stack`](positions/position-stack.qmd) - Stack position adjustment: cumulate y per x bucket.

## [Facets](facets/index.qmd)

- [`facet-grid`](facets/facet-grid.qmd) - Grid facets: panels on a row x col grid from two discrete variables.
- [`facet-wrap`](facets/facet-wrap.qmd) - Wrap facets: one panel per level of a discrete variable.

## [Themes](themes/index.qmd)

- [`element-blank`](themes/element-blank.qmd) - Blank element: hides the corresponding theme element.
- [`element-line`](themes/element-line.qmd) - Line element: colour and thickness.
- [`element-rect`](themes/element-rect.qmd) - Rectangle element: fill and stroke.
- [`element-text`](themes/element-text.qmd) - Text element: font size, weight, colour, and angle.
- [`theme`](themes/theme.qmd) - Build a custom theme from per-element overrides.
- [`theme-classic`](themes/theme-classic.qmd) - Classic theme: white panel, axis borders, no gridlines.
- [`theme-grey`](themes/theme-grey.qmd) - Grey theme: light grey panel with white gridlines.
- [`theme-minimal`](themes/theme-minimal.qmd) - Minimal theme: white panel, light grey gridlines, no axis lines.
- [`theme-void`](themes/theme-void.qmd) - Void theme: no axes, no grid, no panel background.
